verdict.rationale: Raygun's docs mention sending dSYMs and uploading ProGuard mapping files, which implies iOS and Android crash symbolication. They also state Raygun captures full stack traces plus OS, device and version context for each error. However, the pack never explicitly documents native iOS or Android crash SDKs, and it says nothing about NDK/native C/C++ crashes. missing for 10: explicit iOS/Android crash-reporting SDK documentation, any NDK native-crash support, explicit app-version capture on mobile, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture native mobile crashes — iOS, Android, NDK — with the device, OS, and app-version context needed to reproduce them
